Name: Shebna
Summary: Shebna was the steward over Hezekiah's household and a scribe; Isaiah rebuked him for carving himself a grand tomb in the rock, and foretold that he would be thrust from office and replaced by Eliakim.
KeyStory: Isaiah confronted Shebna the treasurer, who was hewing out a sepulchre on high, and announced that God would drive him from his station.
LifeLesson: Office used for self-glory is taken away; God gives it to another.
